text:
Same project, same month, three different forecasts: 1,050, 1,125 and 1,294. All three come from standard earned value formulas.

The numbers: budget 1,000, planned 500, earned 400, spent 450.

Which forecast is right depends on why the project is over:

1. A one-off event that will not repeat: 1,050
2. Performance continues as it is: 1,125
3. The delay will also cost money: 1,294
4. The plan itself is no longer valid: re-estimate from the bottom up

A useful test before a forecast is signed: the efficiency needed to hit it (TCPI) should be close to the efficiency already achieved. Here, finishing on budget needs 1.09 against 0.89 achieved. That budget will not hold, and the report should say so.

Which EAC does your project report, and who decides?

#ProjectControls #EarnedValue #EVM #CostControl #Planning #EPC
